messages:
Evan: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke + bench for Thrace-7B (sparse-attn variant) on the new tiled-kernel branch? Need baseline vs prod kernel for 1k token, batch=1 and batch=8, and a 32k longctx pass. Also check dequant/regression on q4f16.
Maya: I can take it. Which commit/model artifact?
Jun: model artifact is s3://redwood-models/thrace/7b/sparse/v2/model.tar.gz and tests should use commit `tiling-2026-03-10`
Li: starting a quick smoke now on dedicated-t4 pool — will post numbers. kube job id: bench-1742998888
bench-bot: job bench-1742998888 started on pool:dedicated-t4, slots=4
Li: smoke done — generates ok, no OOM. Latency (p50/p95) batch=1 1k tok: 220ms / 350ms. batch=8 1k tok: 580ms / 920ms. 32k longctx (streamed) tail chunk p95: 1.8s — saw KV thrust spikes around token ~16384.
Maya: thanks. Can you upload profile from /tmp/bench-1742998888/prof and the compiled kernel logs? link: s3://redwood-bench/1742998888/results.zip
Li: uploaded. Also saw a small dequant mismatch on q4f16 (0.4% perplexity uptick) — diff and minimal repro in the S3 bundle.
Evan: hmm 0.4% is borderline. Is the diff localized to instruction-like prompts or general?
Li: mostly instruction prompts, examples in s3. Quick check: reran with fallback to q5_kv and quality recovers, perf roughly the same.
Priya: can we try a routing canary: if p95 > 1s for longctx then route to non-tiling kernel on dedicated? I can add a Canary policy.
Jun: added canary rule: if model=thrace-7b and seq>8192 -> route to kernel:legacy-tiling-fallback. Will deploy at 15:15 UTC.
Maya: follow-ups: (1) re-run with kv_prefetch=on, (2) run regression eval set in CI (eval-suite v2026-03-11), (3) log compiled-kernel metrics for next 3 runs.
Evan: thanks team. Action items: Maya to run prefetched rerun, Jun to deploy canary, Priya to monitor quality for next 24h. Marking as done unless new issues. :thumbsup:
